mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer demand, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -2% signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit margins, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures exceeding 2% signals weakening demand and reduced corporate revenues, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals labor market tightness that raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth below 1% combined with a 3-month decline in Housing Starts exceeding 10% signals weakening demand and reduced corporate revenues, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% AND HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
